evaluations.evidence: create a new game by entering a name and an optional description
evaluations.rationale: No other story expresses creating a new game with the same actor, context and goal.

evaluations.evidence: invite estimators by giving them a URL
evaluations.rationale: No other story duplicates the invitation-by-URL requirement; similar stories differ in scope (limits or joining).

evaluations.evidence: start a round by entering an item in a single multi-line text field
evaluations.rationale: No other story requires starting a round using that specific entry mechanism.

evaluations.evidence: see all items we try to estimate this session
evaluations.rationale: Although estimators also see all items (PP-031), the actor (moderator) differs, which is a meaningful distinction.

evaluations.evidence: select an item to be estimated or re-estimated
evaluations.rationale: Substantially duplicates PP-013 (same actor and re-estimation capability is explicitly covered here and in PP-013).

evaluations.evidence: add an item to the list of items to be estimated
evaluations.rationale: No other story expresses the exact add-item requirement for the moderator.

evaluations.evidence: edit an item in the list of items to be estimated
evaluations.rationale: No duplicate story expresses the same edit-item capability for the moderator.

evaluations.evidence: delete an item from the list of items to be estimated
evaluations.rationale: Deletion of an item is not duplicated by any other story.

evaluations.evidence: show all estimates immediately
evaluations.rationale: Distinct from the automatic simultaneous reveal after all estimators (PP-033); this allows moderator-initiated immediate reveal.

evaluations.evidence: accept the average of all estimates
evaluations.rationale: No other story duplicates the specific accept-average functionality.

evaluations.evidence: "estimate" field filled in automatically if all estimators show the same card
evaluations.rationale: This auto-fill-on-unanimous behavior is not substantially contained in any other story.

evaluations.evidence: enter the agreed-upon estimate
evaluations.rationale: Manual entry of the agreed estimate is distinct from automated acceptance behaviors.

evaluations.evidence: estimate a story we estimated earlier in the session again
evaluations.rationale: Substantially contained in PP-005 which already covers selecting an item to be 're-estimated' by the moderator.

evaluations.evidence: import stories from a spreadsheet
evaluations.rationale: Duplicates the same goal as PP-015 (bulk transfer of stories from a spreadsheet) without a meaningful difference in actor or goal.

evaluations.evidence: copy/paste stories from a spreadsheet
evaluations.rationale: Expresses the same requirement as PP-014 (getting stories from a spreadsheet) and is substantially overlapping in goal and actor.

evaluations.evidence: browse through previous games
evaluations.rationale: No other story duplicates browsing previous games for a moderator.

evaluations.evidence: view a transcript of a game
evaluations.rationale: Viewing a transcript is distinct from exporting it (PP-018/PP-019).

evaluations.evidence: export a transcript of a game as a HTML file
evaluations.rationale: Export-as-HTML is distinct from other export formats and from viewing the transcript.

evaluations.evidence: export a transcript of a game as a CSV file
evaluations.rationale: Export-as-CSV differs in format/business rule from other stories, so not a duplicate.

evaluations.evidence: delete a game
evaluations.rationale: No other story duplicates game deletion.

evaluations.evidence: create an account ... name, email address, a password and a username
evaluations.rationale: Account creation is distinct from login, edit, or deletion stories.

evaluations.evidence: log in using my account name and password
evaluations.rationale: Login is not duplicated elsewhere.

evaluations.evidence: change my account details
evaluations.rationale: Account editing is distinct from creation/deletion/login.

evaluations.evidence: delete my account
evaluations.rationale: Account deletion is not duplicated by any other story.

evaluations.evidence: see dates and times in my local timezone
evaluations.rationale: Timezone display requirement is unique in the backlog.

evaluations.evidence: get a password reminder by email
evaluations.rationale: Password reminder via email is not duplicated elsewhere.

evaluations.evidence: select whether to have the team estimate with {0, 1/2, 1, 2, 3, 5, 8, etc.} or {0, 1, 2, 4, 8, 16, 32, etc.}
evaluations.rationale: Card-set selection requirement is distinct.

evaluations.evidence: invite up to 15 estimators
evaluations.rationale: This places a numeric limit on invitations; PP-002 (invite via URL) differs in scope so not duplicate.

evaluations.evidence: join a game by entering my name on the page I received the URL for
evaluations.rationale: Joining via URL is complementary to invitation and not a duplicate.

evaluations.evidence: see the item we're estimating
evaluations.rationale: Displaying the current item to estimators is not duplicated elsewhere.

evaluations.evidence: see all items we will try to estimate this session
evaluations.rationale: Similar to PP-004 but actor is estimator vs moderator, which is a meaningful distinction.

evaluations.evidence: immediately see that an estimate has been given by a specific estimator
evaluations.rationale: Distinct from showing what estimate was given (PP-036); this is about knowing who has submitted.

evaluations.evidence: be shown all estimates at the same time after all estimators have given their estimate
evaluations.rationale: Automatic simultaneous reveal after all have answered is distinct from moderator-initiated reveal.

evaluations.evidence: change my estimate up until the last person selects a card and all are shown
evaluations.rationale: Expresses the same requirement as PP-041 (changing estimate before draw completion) with the same actor and context.

evaluations.evidence: see each estimator's prior estimates for the story being estimated
evaluations.rationale: Prior-estimates-per-estimator is not duplicated by any other story.

evaluations.evidence: see who gave what estimates during the current round
evaluations.rationale: Showing who gave which estimate (values) is distinct from showing who has submitted (PP-032).

evaluations.evidence: start a two-minute countdown timer that all participants can see
evaluations.rationale: Starting a shared timer is not duplicated elsewhere.

evaluations.evidence: have the two-minute timer reset itself as soon as we all play an estimate
evaluations.rationale: Auto-reset behavior is a distinct requirement from starting the timer (PP-037).

evaluations.evidence: scroll back through the stories and estimates from prior rounds
evaluations.rationale: Reviewing prior rounds within a session is not duplicated elsewhere.

evaluations.evidence: always have the cards in the same order across multiple draws
evaluations.rationale: Card ordering consistency is unique in the backlog.

evaluations.evidence: change my estimate as long as the draw has not been completed
evaluations.rationale: Substantially duplicates PP-034 which describes the same ability to change estimate before completion/reveal.

evaluations.evidence: have a small thumbnail photo displayed near where my cards are played
evaluations.rationale: This personalization feature is not duplicated elsewhere.

evaluations.evidence: site which is compliant with XHTML and CSS standards
evaluations.rationale: Standards compliance differs meaningfully from other cross-browser or accessibility stories.

evaluations.evidence: have a list of definitions for commonly used terms
evaluations.rationale: Glossary/definitions requirement is unique.

evaluations.evidence: have created database indexes
evaluations.rationale: Database indexing is a distinct developer-level requirement not duplicated elsewhere.

evaluations.evidence: function correctly in Internet Explorer 6 and 7, Firefox 1.5 and 2, and Safari 2
evaluations.rationale: Specific legacy browser compatibility differs from general standards or accessibility stories.

evaluations.evidence: site comply with the W3C accessibility guidelines where possible
evaluations.rationale: Accessibility compliance is distinct from other developer or UI requirements.

evaluations.evidence: have the application respond quickly to my actions
evaluations.rationale: Performance/responsiveness requirement is unique in the backlog.

evaluations.evidence: be able to use Unicode
evaluations.rationale: Unicode support is distinct and not duplicated elsewhere.

evaluations.evidence: see sensible and predictable URLs
evaluations.rationale: URL structure requirement is unique.

evaluations.evidence: have nice error pages when something goes wrong
evaluations.rationale: Error page design is not duplicated by other stories.

evaluations.evidence: results to be stored in a non-identifiable way
evaluations.rationale: Privacy/anonymization requirement is unique and not duplicated.

evaluations.evidence: be able to see some metrics on use of the game
evaluations.rationale: Analytics/metrics request is unique in the backlog.
